clarification.exposed_model_output: A valid eval response exposes scientific outcome if either message.content or message.thinking contains non-whitespace model-generated text.
clarification.reason: Prevents native reasoning text from being observed without consuming the fresh attempt merely because visible content is empty.
clarification.crash_ambiguity: A prior request-start marker without a durable terminal request record is INVALID_PROVENANCE and cannot be treated as proven pre-outcome.
durable_order: on HTTP/error without model response write request-complete-no-response evidence
on response write raw response atomically
if exposed write durable consumed state before scientific adjudication
